name: range
description: User-defined range types: subtype_diff, an explicit multirange name, a cross-schema range with collation and operator class, and a table using range, multirange and built-in range columns
notes: PostgreSQL creates five constructor functions (LANGUAGE internal) for every range type; they depend internally on the type and are not dumped, as in pg_dump.
A column of a range or multirange type from another schema keeps its schema prefix; built-in int4range and int4multirange stay bare.
multirange_type_name is printed only when it is not the default PostgreSQL would pick (floatspans vs floatspan_multirange); timemultirange is omitted.
timerange names time_diff as its subtype_diff, so it is dumped after the function.
COMMENT ON TYPE is not dumped for any type kind yet, so the comment on timerange is not round-tripped.
